summary.text: Ryan P. Walton of Rutland City, an independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Vermont's at-large U.S. House seat to Becca Balint.
He received 0.9% of the vote to Becca Balint's 65.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
His campaign website describes experience in Vermont real estate, property services, construction and software development; he did not respond to Vermont Public's candidate survey.
